ReadMainFS: Reads file from MainFS, allocating space. A0=DDDDFFFF
FreeMainFS: Free's an allocated MainFS file pointer
SaveFileEncode: A0=start addr of data to encode,A1=encrypt_table_addr,outputs to 0x800CD0C0
SaveFileDecode: A0=start addr of portion to decode,A1=dest_addr,A2=decode_table_addr
GetFadeStatus: returns 0 when fade action is finished
current_star_spawn: 00 for first star spawn, 01 for second star spawn index, etc.
star_spawn_indices: array length 8 of the current star order
board_ram9: free for board use, persists in save game
board_ram10: free for board use, persists in save game
board_ram11: free for board use, persists in save game
board_ram12: free for board use, persists in save game
board_ram13: free for board use, persists in save game
board_ram14: free for board use, persists in save game
board_ram15: free for board use, persists in save game
board_ram16: free for board use, persists in save game
board_ram17: free for board use, persists in save game
cur_player_used_item: 0=Player can use item, 1= Player can't use item
slow_dice_flags: bit0 is P1, bit1 is P2, and so on
p1_forced_dice_roll2: forces p1's second roll when using a mushroom
p1_forced_dice_roll3: forces p1's third roll when using a golden mushroom
p1_spaces_remaining: controls the number above the player's head
p2_forced_dice_roll2: forces p2's second roll when using a mushroom
p2_forced_dice_roll3: forces p2's third roll when using a golden mushroom
p2_spaces_remaining: controls the number above the player's head
p3_forced_dice_roll2: forces p3's second roll when using a mushroom
p3_forced_dice_roll3: forces p3's third roll when using a golden mushroom
p3_spaces_remaining: controls the number above the player's head
p4_forced_dice_roll2: forces p4's second roll when using a mushroom
p4_forced_dice_roll3: forces p4's third roll when using a golden mushroom
p4_spaces_remaining: controls the number above the player's head
p1_status_flags: 0x80 (reset effect you land), 0x40 (apply a bowser head), 0x20 (bowser slow curse head), 0x1 (move in reverse)
ShowPlayerCoinChange: A0=player_index,A1=amount (signed),shows coins +/- next to player ui
PlayerHasItem: A0=player_index,A1=item,returns index of item in player item array, otherwise -1
PlayerHasEmptyItemSlot: A0=player_index,returns index of first empty item slot, otherwise -1
FixUpPlayerItemSlots: A0=player_index,shifts any 0xFF values to the end
AddArrowAngle: F0=degree_rot_of_arrow,0-360,0 is facing normal, rotates counter clockwise as degrees increase
GetSpaceData: A0=space_index,Gets pointer to the space data originating from the board def
GetAbsSpaceIndexFromChainSpaceIndex: A0=chain_index,A1=space_index_in_chain gets true space index from chain+index
GetChainSpaceIndexFromAbsSpaceIndex: A0=abs_space_index,A1=chain_index,returns -1 if abs space not in chain
SetPlayerOntoAbsSpaceIndex: A0=abs_space_index,A1=current_player_chain_ptr,A2=current_player_space_ptr,Sets a player onto a chain and space inferred from an absolute space index
EventTableHydrate: Moves event table data into the space data
ShowMessage: A0=character_index,A1=string index/pointer,A2 onward: string format options
SetPlayerBlue: Sets the player's turn state blue
SetPlayerRed: Sets the player's turn state red
SetPlayerGreen: Sets the player's turn state green
GetSumOfPlayerStars: sums the star count of all players
RNGPercentChance: A0=percent_chance,given a percent chance, returns true at that likelihood
SetPlayerOntoChain: A0=player_index,A1=chain,A2=space, sets cur and next data, assuming next is cur+1
GetPlayerPlacement: A0=player_index,returns 0,1,2,3 based on who is ranked 1st, etc.
GetPlayerPlacementAtEndOfGame: A0=player_index,returns 0,1,2,3 based on who would be ranked 1st if the game ended right now. Functions exactly like GetPlayerPlacement if the Bonus Stars are disabled, but if the Bonus Stars are enabled then the placement returned is based as if the three Bonus Stars are awarded prior to placement.
GetPlayerStruct: A0=player_index pass -1 to get current player's struct
PlayerIsCurrent: A0=player_index tests if A0 is the current player
PlayerHasCoins: A0=player_index,A1=min_coints tests if player coins >= A1
AdjustPlayerCoinsGradual: A0=player_index,A1=amount,like AdjustPlayerCoins but with sounds one at a time
RefreshHUD: A0=player_index,refreshes player hud, or at least the items in the hud
num_minis_in_roulette: Number of Mini-Games to populate the roulette with for each type (4p, 1v3, 2v2, battle, item, duel)
p1_hud_xpos: float for p1's HUD x pos
p1_hud_ypos: float for p1's HUD y pos
